name: ai-eval
description: Gate AI-pipeline changes by user task: run the candidate through the product's own pipeline on a fixed sample set, score the reports a user actually reads (deterministic asserts plus Codex judges, one fresh session per scorer and sample), compare against a stored baseline, and decide pass or fail against the exit criteria written in the project's EVAL.md. Project-agnostic: everything about a project lives in its EVAL.md, which eval-setup generates. Lives in the harold-skills marketplace.
